# Golden digests of the adaptive mesh workload: a tripwire, not an oracle
# (docs/verification.md §4). CRC-32 (core/crc32.hpp) of units 0 and 1 at seed 1:
#
#   input   the generated input (the hotspots, 2048 bytes).
#   counts  the output's leaf counts (exact on every
#           schedule and on every machine).
#   serial  the whole output computed on one slot, where every coarse cell is
#           added leaf by leaf in leaf order: the same bits on x86-64 and on
#           AArch64, because every leaf value is a fixed sequence of plain
#           binary64 operations (spec.hpp) and no fused multiply-add is
#           contracted into it.
#
# Produced by tests/determinism/workloads/adaptive_mesh/determinism_test.cpp,
# which prints every line it computes:
#
#   build/debug/tests/determinism/workloads/adaptive_mesh/loadforge_determinism_workloads_adaptive_mesh_tests \
#     --gtest_filter='*Digest*'
#
# on 2026-10-20 17:40 UTC, on an x86-64 machine (GCC 13.3, debug preset). CI's
# ARM64 runner checks the AArch64 half on real hardware on every run.
#
# A change to these lines is a change to the bits the workload produces, which
# also changes the workload's version (kWorkloadVersion) and is reviewed as
# such.

counts 1 1c02086c
input 0 d12820fd
input 1 935f90fb
serial 0 ec0502e1
